subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this custom cooperative glob walker and yielded `agent:bootstrap` dispatch as the permanent compatibility contract for existing `bootstrap-extra-files` configurations?
rationale: Tests and the supplied benchmark support the performance direction, but only a runtime owner can decide whether the semantic-parity and scheduling tradeoff is acceptable for all existing workspace configurations.

options.title: Approve the runtime contract
options.body: Accept the cooperative walker and bootstrap-only yielded dispatch after owner review of the stated glob-parity and hook-scheduling guarantees.

options.title: Narrow or replace the approach
options.body: Pause this branch and pursue a smaller owner-designed scheduling mechanism that retains the platform glob implementation or otherwise reduces semantic emulation.

recommendation.title: Approve the runtime contract
recommendation.body: Accept the cooperative walker and bootstrap-only yielded dispatch after owner review of the stated glob-parity and hook-scheduling guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent workspace-bootstrap review history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
